concept: EC2 purchasing: Spot for interruptible batch jobs
tests: Choosing the cheapest EC2 purchasing option for a stateless, fault-tolerant batch job that can tolerate interruption.
expected: Spot Instances — the biggest discount, suited to interruptible fault-tolerant work. Triggers: "can tolerate interruption", "stateless", "fault-tolerant", "batch".
why_not: On-Demand — no discount; Reserved Instances — for steady 24/7 load, not a few hours at night; Dedicated Hosts — most expensive, for licensing/compliance.
